snippet.title: Abyssal Apocrypha | DOOM WAD TRAILER
snippet.description:
Abyssal Apocrypha is an MBF21 project inspired by the "Lovecraft Mythos" from Ashtral Fiend et al.

Explore Jungles, Caves, Temples, Old Cities, Houses, laboratories, and uncover the secrets of the old gods in this 24-map-long adventure.

DOWNLOAD LINK: https://www.doomworld.com/forum/topic/159769-abyssal-apocrypha-mbf21/
